name: Monmouth County Audubon Bird Conservation Grant
summary: Small reimbursement grants for one-year habitat projects in Monmouth County, New Jersey that benefit birds, such as native plantings, nest boxes and nesting platforms, open to nonprofits and municipal environmental commissions.
reporting: Grantees complete the project and submit a final report with documentation within one year, plus at least three photos or graphics.

deadline.text: 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026

status.quote: All applications must be submitted by e-mail to mcasconservationgrant@yahoo.com by 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026.

deadline.quote: All applications must be submitted by e-mail to mcasconservationgrant@yahoo.com by 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026.

pool.quote: The Monmouth Audubon Bird Conservation Grant Program will award a maximum of $3,000 in grants for 2026.

applicant_types.quote: All nonprofit 501(c)(3) or 501(c)(4) organizations as well as any of Monmouth County's municipal environmental commissions are eligible to apply

geography.quote: Projects must be located within Monmouth County, New Jersey.

access.quote: The Monmouth County Audubon Society (MCAS) is offering small grants for a one-year project that will advance bird conservation.

window.quote: All applications must be submitted by e-mail to mcasconservationgrant@yahoo.com by 5 p.m. Eastern Standard Time on January 15, 2026.

amount.quote: The maximum request per proposal is $1,500 ($150 is the minimum).

reporting.quote: Grantees have one year to complete projects and submit final report/documentation for reimbursement. Projects running past one year without authorization from MCAS in writing are subject to forfeit their payment. Grantees are required to submit a minimum of 3 representative photos or other graphics for MCAS's use in publications and online.
